# Leaflet 1.9.4

Leaflet JS/CSS bundled locally from the 1.9.4 distribution. License: BSD 2-Clause, see LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4

The layer-control icon is replaced by the project's SVG in images/layers.svg.
Numbered markers use divIcon, so the default PNG marker assets are not used.
